Neuropsychiatric clinic & training institute · Greater Noida, Delhi NCR

Care for your mind. Training for future clinicians.

Mind Grace offers confidential psychiatric, child-development, and counselling consultations in Gamma II, Greater Noida — and supervised clinical training for psychology and medical students.

Consultations & counselling

Evidence-based psychiatry & therapy

Specialized neuropsychiatric & psychological care

Personalized treatment plans that combine medical evaluation, structured talk therapy, and practical family guidance — in a respectful, non-judgmental setting.

Request an appointment

Adult & geriatric psychiatry

Careful diagnostic assessment and medication review, when appropriate, for depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety, schizophrenia-spectrum conditions, and later-life memory concerns.

  • Depression & anxiety care
  • Bipolar mood disorders
  • Schizophrenia-spectrum support
  • Later-life depression & memory
Explore adult psychiatrySpecialized consultations

Clinical psychology & psychotherapy

Individual talk therapy for emotional regulation, grief, trauma, and persistent obsessive or intrusive thoughts, planned around your goals and pace.

  • Evidence-based therapy approaches
  • OCD, panic & PTSD care
  • Trauma & grief support
  • Counselling services
Explore therapy optionsTherapy online in India

Child & adolescent development

Compassionate evaluation of attention, social communication, mood, and school-related distress, with practical conversations for parents and caregivers.

  • ADHD & autism assessment
  • Learning disability assessment
  • Student mental health
  • Child development services

De-addiction & lifestyle wellness

Not sure where to start?

Psychiatry addresses medical evaluation and medication when needed. Psychology and counselling focus on therapy and coping skills. A short conversation with the clinic can help you choose.

Institutional training wing

Programs that connect theory with clinical reality

Students observe ethical practice, practise core assessment skills, and discuss cases with supervision — with clear boundaries around confidentiality and scope.

Review internship guide and terms
Cohort programFlexible duration

Clinical psychology internship

Structured outpatient exposure designed for undergraduate and postgraduate psychology students.

  • Mental status examination (MSE) orientation.
  • Familiarity with DSM-5-TR and ICD-11 diagnostic frameworks.
  • Observed OPD sessions under confidentiality protocols.
Rolling intakesLimited seats per batch
See internship detailsApply via enquiry form
Skill workshopWeekend sessions

Psychometric assessment orientation

Demonstration-led sessions on the purpose, ethics, and interpretation basics of common assessment tools.

  • Overview of projective and intelligence batteries.
  • Report-writing and case-formulation practice tasks.
  • Guidance on test-user qualifications and limits.
Materials listed in advanceHands-on demos
Browse student resources
Brief courseSmall groups

Diagnostic interviewing practicum

Role-play and observed-practice sessions for history-taking, MSE documentation, and referral etiquette.

  • Sample MSE templates and case-discussion format.
  • Ethics, consent, and boundaries discussion.
  • Feedback from supervising clinicians.
Questions to ask before applyingFAQ included
Read training FAQs

Training involves observation and supervised learning activities. It does not confer licensure, prescription rights, or independent clinical practice. Eligibility, tool access, and any certification terms are confirmed individually before enrollment.

Questions about eligibility? See the FAQ or contact the academic desk.
